periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Convened the suicide prevention coalition with 11 organizations and adopted a short charter. Began drafting a shared response protocol for hospital, 911 and school staff. Partners: Bayview Medical Center, Public Safety crisis response, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Recruit partners that serve higher-risk groups and circulate the draft protocol for comment.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Grew the coalition to 14 organizations and circulated a one-page draft protocol to hospital, 911 and school staff. Recruitment of partners serving higher-risk groups added two members but remains slow. Partners: Bayview Medical Center, Public Safety crisis response, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Adopt the protocol at the quarterly meeting at Bayview Medical Center and add library and seaport members.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Grew the coalition to 17 organizations and adopted a one-page response protocol that hospital, 911 and school staff all use. Held the quarterly coalition meeting at Bayview Medical Center with 14 organizations attending. Partners: Bayview Medical Center, Public Safety crisis response, Harborview Unified School District, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Recruit partners from the veteran, LGBTQ+ youth and immigrant-serving groups so that at least 10 members serve higher-risk residents.
